fato_historico: 2023: The 2023 Rotterdam shootings occurred, during which two people were killed in a shooting and arson incident at a residence in Delfshaven, Rotterdam. Additionally, one person lost their life in a classroom at the Erasmus University Medical Center.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to reflect on the fragility of life. Just as the city of Rotterdam once held space for collective healing after a dark storm, your intuition may guide you to be a beacon of empathy today. It is a good time to offer kindness, as gentle ripples of compassion can transform even the most challenging circumstances.
frase_do_dia: Kindness is the lighthouse that guides us through the darkest, foggiest nights.
significado_numero: A powerful master number representing intuition and spiritual insight.
conselho: Consider nurturing your inner world and sharing your gentle light with others.
